title: A Honeymoon on Zanzibar
excerpt: White beaches, dhows at sunset and quiet villas: Zanzibar is a classic honeymoon destination. How to plan it well.
body:
Zanzibar is one of the most popular honeymoon destinations in East Africa, often combined with a safari.

## Where to stay

- **Quiet:** east coast villages like Matemwe, Michamvi and Jambiani.
- **Swimming at any time:** north coast around Kendwa.
- **Private:** small boutique hotels or villas.
- **Islands:** small private islands nearby, such as Chumbe or Mnemba (exclusive and limited).

## Romantic experiences

- A [sunset dhow cruise](/blog/sunset-dhow-cruise/).
- A private dinner on the beach.
- Snorkelling at [Mnemba](/blog/mnemba-atoll-snorkelling/).
- A sandbank picnic.
- A couples' spa treatment.

## Combine with safari

The classic order is safari first, beach last. See [safari and beach honeymoon](/blog/safari-and-beach-honeymoon/).

## Tell the hotel

Many hotels offer a small surprise for honeymooners if you let them know.

Read our [honeymoon page](/tanzania-honeymoon/) or [plan your honeymoon](/travel-proposal/).
